_note: Provenance of the banked chat-template artifacts. Each chat_template.jinja is the verbatim chat_template string from the PINNED upstream tokenizer_config.json revision (the same revision the engines serve and the profiles' tokenizer artifacts were taken from). The sha256 here is what a profile's templateSha256 must pin; the render-parity goldens (kv_chat_render_parity.json) were generated from these exact bytes and re-verify the digest at generation time. bos/eos are the special-token strings a profile's renderPolicy must declare when its template references them.
